jobs.title: Communications Manager - Destination & Experience
jobs.description:
**Communications Manager – London / Chertsey (Flexible hybrid working) | Full-Time / Permanent**
**Up to £50,000 + bonus and excellent benefits including healthcare, wellbeing support, 27 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, life insurance and more.**
We're looking for a strategic and creative Communications Manager to lead internal and external communications across our Destination & Experience sector with a focus on leading retail and education catering brands. This is an exciting opportunity to shape communications campaigns, manage PR activity, build stakeholder relationships and strengthen brand reputation across a diverse portfolio of businesses. If you're passionate about storytelling, media relations and employee engagement, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**We are Compass Group UK&I**
We’re the UK’s largest food and support services provider: the people behind the food, hospitality and services that brighten your day, make you smile and put a spring in your step. Operating in thousands of locations across the UK & Ireland, we provide expert catering, cleaning, and facilities management services to a range of clients and sectors across the country. In the UK and Ireland we’re tens of thousands of talented people providing tasty, well-cooked food and support services to improve the health and wellbeing of workers, school children, hospital patients, military and visitors to the nation’s major sports and cultural events.
  
  
**Communications Manager – The role**

* Lead the delivery of integrated communications strategies and plans across the Destination & Experience sector
* Partner with business and brand leaders to identify and promote impactful business, client and colleague stories
* Oversee PR activity, developing proactive campaigns that enhance profile and protect reputation
* Create high-quality press releases, media statements, leadership content, award entries and briefing materials
* Manage PR agencies and external partners, ensuring delivery against agreed objectives and measurable outcomes
* Create and coordinate engaging content across internal communications channels and platforms
* Advise stakeholders on communication approaches, channels and content strategies
* Track communications performance and use insights to refine plans and demonstrate impact
* Support reputation management, media enquiries and broader communications priorities across the business

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience in communications, corporate communications, PR or corporate affairs
* Strong media relations, stakeholder engagement and content development expertise
* Excellent writing, editorial and proofreading skills across multiple channels and audiences
* Experience developing proactive PR plans and managing communications campaigns
* Strong communication and influencing skills with the confidence to advise stakeholders at all levels
* Experience managing agencies or external partners and evaluating delivery against objectives
* Strong organisational and project management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of reputation management and business priorities
* Collaborative, proactive and solutions-focused approach

**What You'll Get In Return**

* Competitive salary with bonus and full company benefits
* 27 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, your birthday off, and a holiday purchase scheme
* Healthcare & wellbeing: Aviva Digicare, Medicash (dental, optical, therapy treatments)
* Mental health support: 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme
* Family benefits: Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave, plus additional family-friendly benefits
* Perks & discounts: Shopping, entertainment and travel discounts, 20% off Nuffield Health and 10% off PureGym memberships
* Financial wellbeing: Pension scheme, Life Assurance and preferred rates on salary finance products
* Development opportunities: Professional subscriptions, ongoing training and structured career pathways

**Compass Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.**

jobs.title: Senior Partner Marketing Manager - Cloud & Channel
jobs.description:
Datadog’s Partner Marketing Team is looking for a Senior Partner Marketing Manager to drive strategic marketing initiatives with our Cloud Service Providers and Channel Partners in EMEA. In this role, you will own and execute marketing programs designed to increase partner engagement, generate leads, and expand awareness of Datadog’s solutions within the cloud provider and channel ecosystem. This position offers a high-impact opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams and senior leadership while shaping Datadog’s presence with our ecosystem of partners.
  
  
*At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.*
**What You’ll Do:**

* Develop and execute regional partner marketing programs, including webinars, demand generation campaigns, enablement sessions, industry events, and social media initiatives to drive engagement.
* Set cross-team strategy and execute plans, working cross-functionally across product, demand gen, and partnerships teams — often in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.
* Drive coordinated field alignment, co-sell motions, and partner-led pipeline with AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure
* Understand and work within regions and stakeholders across the South EMEA region to build the partner ecosystem
* Track and analyze the effectiveness of partner marketing initiatives, reporting on key performance metrics through internal and external quarterly OKRs to ensure continuous optimization.
* Translate partnership data into clear ROI narratives for leadership and client/partner audiences.This includes presenting partnership marketing strategies and results to stakeholders while demonstrating clear ROI and strategic value
* Build and own our EMEA presence at global conferences like AWS Reinvent, DASH and Google Cloud Next

**Who You Are:**

* 6-8 years of experience working in marketing; partner marketing and/or high-tech B2B marketing preferred
* Fluent in English (Datadog’s business language). Italian, Spanish or Arabic are nice to have.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive-level communication skills - the ability to build trust and influence across internal teams and partner organizations of varying sizes and seniority.
* You have a track record of turning co-marketing programs into pipeline - past campaigns generated measurable marketing-sourced revenue
* You are a strategic and analytical thinker paired with hands-on execution — you are equally comfortable setting vision and rolling up sleeves to run campaigns.
* Strong project management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to influence others
* You have experience with Salesforce or similar CRM tools
* Comfortable utilising AI in daily work
* This role requires 3 days a week in office
* Ability to travel 20% of the time

*Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.*
**Benefits and Growth:**

* New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
* Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
* Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
* An inclusive company culture, opportunity to join our Community Guilds
* Generous and competitive benefits package
* Continuous career development and pathing opportunities

*Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.*
**About Datadog:**
Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity at Datadog:**
Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference.
  
  
Datadog endeavors to make our Careers Page accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please complete this form. This form is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
  
  
**Privacy and AI Guidelines:**
Any information you submit to Datadog as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Datadog’s Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice. For information on our AI policy, please visit Interviewing at Datadog AI Guidelines.

jobs.title: Customer Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
The position available is for a Lifecycle & Retention Marketing Manager who will be pivotal in devising and implementing strategies for the
**post-sale lifecycle**
. This role focuses on activating, engaging, retaining, and expanding the network of AvePoint customers. It is of utmost importance for enhancing customer value throughout their lifecycle, from onboarding to product education, retention, reactivation, and ultimately expansion.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The responsibilities of the role include:
  
  

* Ownership and scaling of the B2B post-sale lifecycle strategy, guiding it through the stages of onboarding, activation, adoption, retention, and expansion.
* Experience in product-led growth lifecycle: Use product-usage, intent, and health signals to trigger personalised journeys that accelerate activation, deepen adoption, identify product-qualified expansion opportunities, and improve retention.
* Designing lifecycle programs aimed at future growth, including automated onboarding processes and adoption campaigns triggered by customer actions.
* Utilizing customer engagement data to unearth attach opportunities and enhance lifecycle performance.
* Developing and refining customer communications across diverse channels such as email, in-app messaging with personalised interventions at scale
* Collaborating closely with the Customer Success and Product Marketing to facilitate post-sale, renewal nurturing, and reactivation efforts.
* Leading data-driven experimentation and optimization efforts through methods such as A/B testing to continuously refine lifecycle processes.
* Establishing lifecycle KPIs and routinely reporting on results to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and accountability in customer satisfaction metrics.

**Key Performance Indicators**
Success in this role is measured through specific customer and commercial outcomes: not engagement rates alone. This includes:
  
  

* Improved onboarding completion and activation rates, reducing time to first value.
* Higher adoption of priority features and repeat, habitual product usage.
* A product-led lifecycle that uses behavioural, product-usage, and customer-health signals to deliver timely, personalised interventions at scale.
* Earlier identification and conversion of product-qualified growth signals, supporting upsell, cross-sell, and revenue growth.
* Reduced churn and stronger retention, renewal, GRR, and NRR outcomes.
* Robust lifecycle segmentation and trigger-based journeys that scale across customer tiers, maturity stages, and account potential.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**
Candidates for this role should possess:
  
  

* A minimum of 5 years of experience in lifecycle, retention, Gainsight, focusing on B2B audiences.
* Familiarity with Gainsight is a plus
* Experience designing and scaling customer lifecycle programmes across multiple delivery models; including direct, partner-led, reseller, and managed-service routes to market, while maintaining a consistent digital customer experience and clear ownership model.
* Comprehensive understanding of the post-sale B2B customer journey, including onboarding, product adoption, retention, and expansion strategies.
* Proven experience in designing lifecycle journeys using behavioural signals rather than solely relying on time-based communication.
* Strong analytical skills, facilitating the translation of customer insights into impactful marketing strategies.
* An ability to thrive in cross-functional collaboration with teams across Product, Sales, and Demand Gen departments.

**Benefits We Offer**

* Market-competitive compensation including bonus scheme
* Career progression and internal mobility opportunities
* 30 days of annual leave, in addition to public holidays
* GBP 1.000,00/Year towards our Tuition Reimbursement Program
* Company pension scheme
* Private medical insurance
* Employee Referral Program
* Corporate Donation Matching Program
* Maternity policy
* Company sponsored events / regular team building events
* Extra paid perk days - Birthday off, Family/Life Event Day, Volunteering...

Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Digital Content Manager
jobs.description:
**Locations**
: London | Lisbon
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a member of BCG’s Digital Marketing team, you will play a key role in continuously improving BCG.com, our primary digital content platform. Working with the Digital Content Director, you will execute global priorities that strengthen the quality, discoverability, and effectiveness of our website content while helping create a more connected experience across the broader customer journey.
  
  
You will take a global, end-to-end view of how content is developed, optimized, and experienced across BCG’s digital presence. You will bring together insights from performance data, evolving search and AI-driven discovery behaviors, user experience principles, and digital content practices to identify opportunities for improvement. You will also help strengthen the processes and cross-functional ways of working that enable teams to deliver high-quality content efficiently and consistently.
  
  

* Drive global website content optimization initiatives aligned with priorities established by the Digital Content Director.
* Identify opportunities to improve content quality, discoverability, and user experience using performance insights and evolving search behaviors.
* Connect website optimization with relevant search, social, and email touchpoints to support a cohesive customer journey.
* Partner across Digital Marketing, Global Marketing, Practice Areas, and other teams to coordinate priorities, dependencies, and delivery.
* Manage complex, cross-functional projects from planning through execution, maintaining clear timelines, responsibilities, risks, and outcomes.
* Develop and share practical guidance that strengthens digital content practices and cross-functional ways of working globally.
* Support website taxonomy and content governance, incorporating commercial priorities, discoverability standards, and user experience principles.
* Communicate progress, insights, risks, and recommendations clearly to marketing colleagues and senior leaders.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, digital media, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in digital content strategy and execution, with significant focus on website content.
* Strong digital content and search expertise, including an understanding of evolving AI-driven search and discoverability.
* Advanced project and program management skills, with experience delivering complex, concurrent initiatives across multiple teams.
* Ability to use digital performance data and insights to identify opportunities and inform content decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex information clear and actionable.
* Experience working across matrixed organizations, building relationships and influencing colleagues without formal authority.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will be part of BCG’s global Digital Marketing organization, within the Content Discoverability team, and report to the Digital Content Director. You will work closely with colleagues across Digital Marketing and Global Marketing, including Practice Area marketing teams, local marketing teams, Specialty Businesses, and Content Studio, as well as digital experts across web, website development, customer experience, and user experience. Together, these teams collaborate to strengthen BCG’s digital content and create connected experiences across the customer journey.
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

jobs.title: Environmental Services Mobilisation, Communications & Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Contract terms
  
  
**Starting salary: PO4 (£50,676 – £53,919)
  
  
Work location: Alexandra house, 10 Station Road, Wood Green, London, N22 7TR**
**Hours per week: 36 per week**
**Contract type: Fixed term contract (18 months from start date**
**Closing date: Sunday, 22nd November 2026 at 23:59
  
  
Expected interview date: W/c 7th December 2026**
**If you are intending on going for a secondment opportunity, please ensure you have notified your line manager/head of service to seek approval**
**About Haringey**
Haringey is a fantastic place to live and work – the world in one borough. A place brimming with creativity, personality, radicalism, and community. It is a place where we stand up for each other. A place that is proudly distinctive. We’ll be celebrating all this and more as the “rebel borough” when we are the 2027 London Borough of Culture.
  
  
Our history champions change-makers and everyday rebels; revelling in our differences, battling discrimination, championing equality, and doing things our own way. Haringey’s people are a huge asset, with knowledge, expertise, and passion. Our staff members embody our organisational values: Caring, Creative, Courageous, Collaborative and Community-focused. These values keep us looking forward, ambitious for the future, and continuously striving to do our very best for all of our residents.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced and creative Communications & Engagement Manager with a passion for behaviour change. You will lead high-profile mobilisation programmes, supporting residents, businesses and stakeholders through service changes by delivering strategic communications and engagement that build awareness, understanding and participation. Working across a range of priorities, including environmental and waste services, you will design creative, insight-led campaigns that encourage positive behaviours, influence attitudes and drive real-world action. Through compelling storytelling, audience insight and data-driven evaluation, you will help deliver meaningful outcomes for communities across Haringey.
  
  
**About The Team**
Based within the Corporate Communications service, you will work closely with colleagues across Communications, Recycling, Waste and Waste Enforcement, as well as senior leaders, elected members and external partners. The team is passionate about delivering high-quality communications that put residents at the heart of everything we do. Working collaboratively across the organisation, you will help shape campaigns that support Haringey’s environmental ambitions and strengthen engagement with our diverse communities.
  
  
**About You**
You will be a skilled communications professional with experience leading complex campaigns and delivering meaningful engagement programmes. You will have excellent writing and presentation skills, the ability to translate complex information into clear and accessible messages, and a strong understanding of digital communications, marketing and stakeholder engagement. Most importantly, you will be passionate about working with communities, using insight to shape communications, and ensuring all residents have opportunities to influence and engage with changes that affect them.
  
  
Working for Haringey
  
  
At Haringey Council we are committed to creating a workplace culture where all our people feel valued, included, and able to be their best at work, and we recognise the benefits of a diverse workforce so welcome applications from all ethnicities and communities so that we continue to make a difference to our residents and community. Our benefits package includes a leave entitlement of 31 days + bank holidays, potential hybrid working opportunities, health and wellbeing support, a generous local government pension scheme and a range of discount schemes across leisure and culture that provide both financial and money-saving discounts.
  
  
Please note: we reserve the right to end this advert before the noted deadline if we receive sufficient applications. If you wish to apply for this role, please ensure that you do so as soon as possible.
  
  
Additionally, we are aware that automated emails may be diverted through to junk email folders. Please continue to check these through the application process. If you have any questions about the status of your application, please contact ResourcingHub@haringey.gov.uk

jobs.title: Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

You’ll join Bain’s UK Market Reputation team, working closely with our Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA) Market Reputation leadership, local office leadership and colleagues across Marketing.

Together, we develop and deliver marketing initiatives that strengthen Bain’s reputation, build relationships with senior executives and engage priority business audiences across the UK.

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

As Manager, UK Market Reputation, you’ll play a key role in strengthening Bain’s reputation and market presence in the UK.

Combining strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, you’ll translate commercial priorities into integrated marketing programmes spanning thought leadership, digital and social media, events, conferences and external communications.

You’ll have meaningful ownership, from shaping marketing strategies and advising senior stakeholders to leading campaigns, measuring their impact and identifying opportunities to improve how we engage our audiences.

Based in London, you’ll report to the Senior Manager, UK Market Reputation.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* **Marketing strategy and programme delivery:**
  Partner with senior leaders to understand commercial priorities, identify target audiences and develop integrated marketing strategies. Lead multi-channel programmes from planning through execution, measurement and optimisation.
* **Digital marketing and social media:**
  Develop, execute and evaluate digital campaigns using global and local content. Create engaging social media activity that reaches priority audiences, builds awareness and drives engagement.
* **Conferences and events:**
  Plan and deliver executive thought-leadership events, including speaker engagement and third-party partnerships. Identify and manage relevant conferences and sponsorship opportunities to strengthen Bain’s market presence.
* **Public relations and external communications:**
  Partner with our global public relations team to support local media activity, build relationships with business and trade journalists, develop stories and amplify thought leadership.
* **Content marketing:**
  Adapt global content for UK audiences and develop integrated promotion plans across digital channels, social media and events.
* **Local office priorities:**
  Support client development initiatives for priority accounts and manage internal office communications.
* **Performance and planning:**
  Partner with the Senior Manager, UK Market Reputation, on annual planning, budget management, market intelligence and performance reporting. Use marketing data and technology to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:**
  Work closely with Practice Marketing, Account Marketing and our in-house centres of excellence to ensure marketing activities are aligned, complementary and commercially relevant.
* **Innovation and continuous improvement:**
  Bring fresh thinking to marketing programmes, campaigns, tools and processes, identifying opportunities to strengthen our impact and effectiveness.
* **People leadership:**
  Manage and develop junior marketers, supporting their professional growth and fostering a collaborative, high-performing team environment.

**ABOUT YOU**

* You bring at least seven years of relevant business-to-business (B2B) marketing experience, including five years in a professional services or client environment, with a strong track record of delivering results.
* You have extensive experience developing and delivering integrated, multi-channel marketing programmes, managing projects from initial strategy through execution and performance evaluation.
* You are confident partnering with senior stakeholders, translating commercial objectives into marketing priorities and influencing decisions with minimal supervision.
* You have strong digital marketing expertise, including experience creating, managing and optimising campaigns to achieve measurable results.
* You are comfortable analysing marketing performance data and using insights to inform decisions, improve effectiveness and demonstrate impact.
* You bring excellent project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, coordinate cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality work.
* You are a collaborative, client-focused professional who enjoys working across international teams in a global organisation.
* You communicate clearly and effectively, with fluent written and spoken English and the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
* You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in marketing, communications or business.

**Additional experience that would be beneficial:**

* Experience in private equity or financial services.
* Familiarity with marketing and event management platforms such as Cvent and Cortex.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
We’re hiring a Product Marketing Lead to own our positioning and make a clear, compelling case for why businesses should choose spektr.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. You’ll own our positioning and produce everything from launch messaging to customer stories, product content and pitch decks. You’ll work closely with marketing, product and our commercial team to turn what spektr does into stories and content that open doors and move deals forward.
  
  
**About Us**
*Compliance, built like product.*
Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.
  
  
We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.
  
  
It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.
  
  

* $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.
* Founders who have done this before. Mikkel and Cip built HelloFlow together and sold it to Trulioo in 2022. They’re now building spektr alongside co-founders Jan-Erik and Jeremy, taking on a much bigger part of the customer lifecycle.
* Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.
* Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own spektr’s positioning and messaging across onboarding, monitoring and investigations, making a complex platform clear and compelling for Product, Operations and Compliance teams.
* Create content that drives our pipeline, from product pages and guides to thought leadership, customer stories, videos and campaign assets.
* Help lead product launches, working with our product team to create messaging and content that clearly demonstrates the value that spektr delivers.
* Build the materials our commercial team needs to win, including pitch decks, battlecards, one-pagers and tailored content for priority accounts.
* Stay close to the competition and the market, turning what you learn into sharper positioning and a clearer case for choosing spektr.
* Spend time with customers and prospects to understand their problems and the language they use, and bring what you learn into our messaging and content.

**How We Work**
We don’t do generic marketing. We send custom comics, make engaging films with our customers and build campaigns around the accounts we most want to win. But of course sometimes a well-written guide or a sharp one-pager is exactly what’s needed. You’ll have the freedom to work out what will resonate, try it and learn from what works.
  
  
You’ll be close to the product and the deals. Product, engineering, our commercial team and the founders all get involved, giving you the people and context you need to get the story right. Bring a good idea and you’ll find people who want to help make it happen.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* You have experience nailing positioning and product launches at a B2B company, and can show us the messaging, content and commercial materials you’ve personally created. Ideally, you’ve done this for a business selling into financial services, fintech or another regulated industry.
* A strong writer who can make complex products clear without losing what makes them different.
* Comfortable getting into the details of a product and figuring out how it solves a real business problem.
* Curious about customers. You enjoy talking to them, listening well and turning what you hear into better messaging.
* Productive and hands-on. You enjoy getting work out into the world, not just planning it.
* Collaborative and persuasive, able to bring product, marketing and our commercial team together around a clear, consistent story.

Your route into product marketing might have been through content, consulting, marketing, or a product role. We’re interested in what you’ve taken responsibility for, how you think and the quality of what you produce. Prior compliance experience is a plus but isn’t a requirement.
  
  
**Why join**

* Shape the story of a category. Compliance technology is changing fast and you’ll help define how the market understands it.
* Market a product you can believe in. Get hands-on with a platform already used by demanding financial businesses, solving problems that matter to them.
* Take ownership of your work and its impact. You’ll have the freedom to make decisions and take ideas through to delivery, with accountability for the results, not just the output.
* Have room to be creative. Try new formats, campaigns and ideas, with support from people across the company.
* See your work help move deals forward. Your content and positioning will be used in live conversations with some of the biggest names in financial services.
* Grow with a team that moves fast. Join our marketing team at an early stage, with room to grow as we do. You’ll need to adapt quickly, take initiative and be willing to get stuck in wherever you’re needed with the determination to find a way forward when things get difficult.

**The process**

* Initial conversation with our VP of Marketing
* Case study presented to a small panel
* Final conversation with our CEO

jobs.title: Senior Content and Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Refractal**
Refractal is an AI security company building the infrastructure organisations need to defend against autonomous AI threats. 2026 has shown that generally capable intelligence is here. The challenge now is modernising security to stop AI-enabled threats, whether they come from internal agents going rogue or from attackers using AI to become more dangerous.
  
  
Refractal was founded on cybersecurity and AI expertise from MIT, Microsoft, NASA and the U.S. Navy. Our product lets organisations detect AI-enabled threats at low cost without sacrificing detection quality. We take a practical approach to AI risk, combining proven cybersecurity methods with frontier AI security research.
  
  
Today, we work with governments and organisations that can't afford to get security wrong. We're backed by leading deep-tech and cybersecurity investors and are growing the team to deliver on this mission.
  
  
The role
  
  
You'll lead Refractal's content and marketing, writing about AI security for security, risk and technology leaders and running the programmes that turn that interest into sales pipeline.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Write and publish technical content, including blog posts, research write-ups, guides and white papers on AI threats and AI security.
* Turn customer work and research findings into case studies and launch stories.
* Build sales enablement materials: decks, one-pagers, battle cards and email copy.
* Run campaigns, webinars and events with sales and partners across the UK and Europe.
* Manage our website, LinkedIn presence and newsletter, and measure what drives pipeline.

Success in your first six months
  
  

* We publish on a steady cadence, and security buyers read, share and cite our content in sales conversations.
* Sales has current, consistent materials for every stage of the cycle.
* Marketing-sourced pipeline is tracked and growing.

About you: essential
  
  

* 5+ years in content or product marketing at a B2B technology company, ideally in security or developer tools.
* Exceptional writing, with the ability to explain a technical topic clearly without oversimplifying it. Please include two or three samples with your application.
* Comfort working with engineers and researchers to get the details right.
* Experience running campaigns end to end and tying them to pipeline.
* Hands-on experience with HubSpot or similar, and with AI tools in your own workflow.

Nice to have
  
  

* A technical or security background.
* An audience you've built through writing or speaking.

Our values
  
  
**Radical transparency.**
We believe the best work happens when everyone feels able to give and receive honest, constructive feedback.
  
  
**Public service.**
We see AI security as a form of public service. Getting the AI transition right means putting the right infrastructure in place to manage the threats that come with it, and our work helps protect the institutions and services society depends on.
  
  
**Fail fast.**
We test ideas early, seek feedback and learn quickly. We experiment rapidly and change course when something isn't working, without compromising on security.
  
  
**Pragmatism, not dogmatism.**
We choose approaches based on how well they solve the problem. That means combining established cybersecurity methods with frontier AI research, questioning our assumptions, and changing our minds when the evidence changes.
  
  
**Compensation And Benefits**

* Salary: £60,000–£105,000
* Competitive equity to share in Refractal's growth
* Pension contribution
* Private medical and dental cover
* Visa and relocation support

Compensation Range: £60K - £105K

**We power people’s progress.**
At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.
  
  
We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.
  
  
Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.
  
  
**Meet the team**
Reporting to the Sr Director Brand Strategy, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping how Preply shows up to our global tutor community and the broader education ecosystem.
  
  
You’ll sit at the intersection of brand, supply marketing, and long term impact, ensuring that how we speak to tutors reflects who we are as a company and the value we bring to their professional growth. You’ll build a cohesive supply brand narrative that connects positioning, educational initiatives, and their experience.
  
  
Working closely with the Supply Engagement team and cross functional stakeholders, you’ll translate strategic brand thinking into meaningful initiatives that strengthen trust, pride, and credibility among tutors. From educational content formats to thought leadership initiatives, you’ll help elevate Preply’s reputation not just as a platform, but as a long term partner in tutors’ careers.
  
  
This is a senior, expert-track leadership role: its seniority comes from the scope of impact and influence it drives, not from the size of a team.
  
  
You’ll own initiatives that shape how tutors perceive Preply globally, strengthening our image externally in the education space. By building long term brand foundations and scalable content ecosystems, you’ll help position Preply as the leading destination for ambitious educators who want to grow, succeed, and belong.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Tutor Brand / Supply Comms to build and elevate the Preply brand within our global tutor community.
  
  
This is a long term brand building role focused on shaping how tutors perceive, experience, and advocate for Preply. You will define the narrative for our tutor audience and lead high impact initiatives that strengthen trust, pride, and professional identity within our community.
  
  
This is not a supply acquisition or performance marketing role. Instead, you will focus on strategic positioning, community storytelling, educational content initiatives, and long term reputation building for Preply as the best place for tutors to grow their careers.

**Tutor Brand Narrative and Positioning.**

* Own and evolve the brand narrative for our tutor community together with the Supply Engagement team
* Ensure we are seen not just as a platform, but as a long term partner in tutors’ professional growth.
* Clarify and articulate Preply’s value proposition for tutors across different personas and maturity stages.
* Ensure consistency between what we promise tutors and what they experience.

**Educational and Thought Leadership Initiatives**
that elevate Preply’s image in the broader education space
  
  

* Develop long term content initiatives that elevate tutors professionally, such as educational content channels, expert series, learning formats, and video programs.
* Build scalable content ecosystems that position Preply as a leader in online education
* Partner with educators and internal stakeholders to create meaningful, high quality educational content.
* Identify strategic opportunities to build credibility among educators globally.
* Own budget and vendor relationships: agencies, tutor ambassadors supporting tutor-facing content.
* Shape how Preply talks to tutors about AI’s role in teaching, translating our human-led, AI-enhanced vision into content that builds tutor confidence rather than anxiety about their professional relevance.
* Define and own success metrics for the tutor brand, such as tutor trust/NPS, retention among top-tier tutors, and reach and engagement of thought-leadership content.
* Partner directly with Supply/Tutor Success teams on major narrative moments and strategic bets.

**What You Need To Succeed**

* 10 + years of experience in brand comms aimed at partner marketing in a fast paced/ tech environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a sharp eye for clarity and tone
* Strong strategic storytelling and positioning skills
* Experience building long term brand initiatives, not just short term campaigns
* Ability to think in formats and ecosystems such as content channels, series, and education programs
* Deep understanding of community building and professional identity
* Strong cross functional collaboration skills
* Track record of driving brand impact at scale through influence rather than headcount, comfortable owning outcomes without a direct-report team
